summary.en: Naeko is rushing to the police station due to daydreaming about Chiba finally recognizing her again when she meets Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys. While waiting for the traffic light to allow them to walk, Naeko teaches the boys about traffic signs, which are heard by a mysterious man who also looks furious about traffic laws after they are allowed to go. At work, Sato is discussing with Yumi and Naeko about her stakeout when Takagi and Chiba come to inform Sato to help them with their stakeout, Yumi then pushes Naeko toward Chiba to create an opportunity for their conversation, but Chiba doesn’t recommend her in the stakeout because she looks like a secondary student taught by the police. Later that day, Naeko is having a Karaoke with Shiroi Yagi and Touko Momosaki, who are also raising suspicion about a stalker targeting them. After Yagi takes the drunken Naeko home, Momosaki receives a strange request from a mysterious man that we might have seen earlier, however, this does not turn out very well for her as this was a set up to lure her into her death. When she was fighting with a masked man while returning house, she is stunned in the ankle and later killed by the masked man.
